items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases
items.content:
Describe the interface you need in plain English, then let the agent build a live surface you can both use and update—so you spend less time adapting to tools and more time getting work done.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Describe the interface you need in plain English, then let the agent build a live surface you can both use and update—so you spend less time adapting to tools and more time getting work done.
The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Kayla Cinnamon

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot应用入门：如何使用画布构建自定义工作流。通过用普通英语描述所需界面，代理将构建一个可共同使用和更新的实时界面，帮助用户减少适应工具的时间，更专注于完成工作。该文章首发于GitHub博客。
summaries.en: The article "GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases" explains how to create custom workflows using GitHub Copilot. Users describe their desired interface in plain English, and the agent generates a live, collaborative surface that can be updated together. This approach aims to reduce time spent adapting to tools and increase productivity. The article was originally published on The GitHub Blog.

How we fully migrated github.com away from CSS-in-JS.

items.creator: Josh Black

summaries.zh: 文章探讨了设计系统如何通过推送更多CSS来提升网站性能，并展示了这一过程并未引发重大问题。该改进措施有效优化了资源加载，提升了用户体验。GitHub博客发布此文，分享了实践经验和成功案例。
summaries.en: The article discusses how a design system successfully shipped significant CSS changes without disrupting operations. It highlights strategies for improving site performance by increasing CSS delivery, emphasizing careful planning and execution. The focus is on maintaining stability while enhancing performance through larger CSS updates. The GitHub Blog originally published the post.

items.title: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
items.content:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.

The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.
The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Alberto Gimeno

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot 实现了在应用中渲染百万行的大代码合并请求，并支持数百条行内评论。该应用通过重建差异界面，优化了大规模代码的加载和显示性能。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot app was updated to efficiently render very large pull requests, up to a million lines with hundreds of inline comments. The team rebuilt the diff surface to handle such massive files, improving performance and usability. This update enables smoother navigation and review of extensive code changes. The changes were announced on The GitHub Blog.

items.title: Developers want more efficient software. Here’s what over 1,000 GitHub users told us they need.
items.content:
New research from GitHub and Yale Program on Climate Change Communication finds strong demand for tools, measurement, and practical guidance that can help developers reduce wasted compute.

The post Developers want more efficient software. Here’s what over 1,000 GitHub users told us they need. appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
New research from GitHub and Yale Program on Climate Change Communication finds strong demand for tools, measurement, and practical guidance that can help developers reduce wasted compute.
The post Developers want more efficient software. Here’s what over 1,000 GitHub users told us they need. appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Paull Young

summaries.zh: GitHub与耶鲁气候变化沟通项目联合研究发现，超过1000名GitHub用户强烈呼吁开发更高效的软件工具、测量方法和实用指南，以减少计算资源浪费。该调查结果揭示了开发者对提升软件效率的迫切需求。
summaries.en: GitHub and Yale's research reveals that over 1,000 GitHub users prioritize tools, measurement, and practical guidance to enhance software efficiency and reduce wasted compute. The findings highlight a strong demand for solutions that help developers optimize their work.

items.creator: Stephen Toub

summaries.zh: GitHub将Copilot代理运行时迁移至Rust语言，涉及80万行生产级Rust代码。此次重写因代理技术而变得可行，文章详细介绍了迁移过程及成果。该内容源自GitHub博客。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot runtime was migrated to Rust, a 800,000-line production codebase. This rewrite was previously unfeasible but became possible with new agent capabilities. The article details the process and outcomes of porting the Copilot agent runtime to Rust. (Word count: 50)

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
items.content:
Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs. Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs. Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app.
The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Kayla Cinnamon

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot应用入门指南：使用diff、终端和浏览器功能。该应用支持在GitHub Copilot中同时查看代码diff、运行终端命令和预览网页应用，方便用户在多个任务间高效切换。通过这些功能，用户可以更便捷地管理代码和项目。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot app allows beginners to efficiently view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side. This integration reduces the need to switch tabs, streamlining the coding process. The app enhances productivity by providing a unified interface for these essential tasks. For more details, refer to "GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser" on The GitHub Blog.
